results.content: # Significance of Kleibergen–Paap test. Kleibergen–Paap test: The Kleibergen–Paap test is employed to assess if instrumental variables are under-identified, with the null hypothesis suggesting they are. This test utilizes statistics such as the rk LM statistic and the F statistic to evaluate both underidentification and weak identification within the context of instrumental variables analysis. It is a crucial tool in ensuring the validity and reliability of instrumental variable regressions. Synonyms: Underidentification test, Weak identification test. The Kleibergen–Paap test assesses underidentification and weak identification in instrumental variables analysis. It tests if the instrumental variables are under-identified, with the null hypothesis stating that they are. (1) The Kleibergen–Paap test is used to test whether instrumental variables are under-identified, with the original hypothesis being that they are under-identified. Been trying to understand the ivreg2 output as well and my understanding now is that the Hansen J statistic in this case does not provide you with any information because your model is exactly identified. results.content:
Title: Kleibergen–Paap rk LM: Significance and symbolism
# Significance of Kleibergen–Paap rk LM. The Kleibergen–Paap rk LM statistic is a crucial test for instrumental variable analysis. It assesses the under-identification of the instrument group. This statistic verifies the relevance of instruments, ensuring they are sufficiently correlated with the endogenous variable. A low statistic indicates weak instrument correlation, potentially leading to biased results. Therefore, a strong Kleibergen–Paap rk LM statistic is desired for reliable instrumental variable estimation. Synonyms: Rank, Test statistic, Lm test, Underidentification test. The below excerpts are indicatory and do represent direct quotations or translations. It is your responsibility to fact check each reference. ## The concept of Kleibergen–Paap rk LM in scientific sources. The Kleibergen–Paap rk LM statistic tests for under-identification in instrumental variable regressions. It assesses the relevance of instruments, ensuring they are not weakly correlated with the endogenous variable. From: *International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (MDPI)*. (1) The Kleibergen–Paap rk LM statistic is used to test for under-identification of the instrumental variable group, ensuring that the instruments are relevant and not weakly correlated with the endogenous variable.
